milestone: fresh evaluator-v3 retraversal bound to generated truncation QC
decision_changed: replace absent-QC UNMEASURED amplitude endpoints with measured post-QC endpoints for the existing REF384 versus existing-corrected-B384 diagnostic comparison only
cheapest_adequate_test: one saved-output-only evaluator-v3 traversal of the two existing real arms
requirements: Verify the request, accepted-source, accepted-traversal-review, QC-result, and H1 post-execution-review manifests before launch.
Refuse launch if output, staging, or Numba-cache path already exists; never overwrite a prior traversal.
Copy accepted source byte-for-byte into the fresh writable staging directory and attest all five imported module origins and hashes before and after execution.
Use the exact config in this packet; preserve REF384 and B384 expected_identity_digest values and exact regenerated-QC byte hashes.
Run under an independently surviving systemd user service with Restart=no, CPU quota at most 400%, MemoryMax at most 16 GiB, RuntimeMaxSec at most 3600, and one start only.
Set NUMBA_CACHE_DIR to the fresh writable cache directory and PYTHONPATH to the staged source directory.
Read saved outputs only. Do not read recording voltage or launch sorting, training, detection, RF, holdout, waveform capture, or regeneration.
Preserve stdout, stderr, service status, effective command/environment, runtime/resource observations, input/QC hashes, output inventory, and final exit status.
Publish a compact immutable H5 result/review packet to shared storage; write its COMPLETE.json last and do not include large caches.
Report identity as UNRESOLVED and waveform as UNMEASURED regardless of numeric evaluator endpoints.
stop_conditions: any manifest, source-module, saved-array identity, QC digest, clock, or path binding mismatch
preexisting output, staging, or cache namespace
unexpected recording/voltage, RF/holdout, sorting/training/detection, or waveform access
service exit, timeout, memory failure, or output-generation failure
completion_condition: one successful managed traversal plus a separately published immutable H5 result/review packet with exact provenance and no retry
